CadProject.title: CadProject
CadProject.description: Represents a 3D parametric CAD project or assembly stored in Firebase Cloud Storage (Firestore).

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this CAD project.

componentsJson.description: Serialized list of 3D CAD parametric components, shapes, booleans, fillets, holes, threads, and transforms.

explodeFactor.description: Saved explosion distance factor (0.0 to 1.0) for multi-part assembly view.

multiObject3mf.description: Whether 3MF exports keep each component as a separate mesh object for multi-color slicers.

partCount.description: Total number of 3D components in the assembly.

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp populated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

PrinterProfile.title: PrinterProfile
PrinterProfile.description: Represents a local or remote 3D printer endpoint (OctoPrint, Moonraker/Klipper, PrusaLink, Bambu Connect) owned by the user.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated Google user who owns this printer profile.

protocol.description: Protocol type: OCTOPRINT, MOONRAKER, PRUSALINK, or CLOUD_SLICER.

endpointUrl.description: Base HTTP/HTTPS URL or IP address of the printer or remote print server.

apiKey.description: Optional API key or token for printer authentication.

/cad_projects/{projectId}.description: User-owned 3D parametric CAD projects and assemblies.

/printer_profiles/{printerId}.description: User-owned local and remote 3D printer profiles.
